title: 4-laning of Greenfield Expressway Package-III (EPC)
story: Clean PASS — but the auditor proves which cited works lack a client reference letter.
text:
Section 2 — Eligibility Criteria
2.1 Similar works: The bidder should have satisfactorily completed similar works (roads, highways or expressways) during the last 7 years ending on the last date of bid submission, for Central Government / State Government / PSU clients, as under: (a) one similar completed work costing not less than 80% of the estimated cost of INR 250 Cr; or (b) two similar completed works each costing not less than 60% of the estimated cost; or (c) three similar completed works each costing not less than 40% of the estimated cost. Client reference letters shall be enclosed for each work claimed.
2.2 Financial turnover: Average annual financial turnover during the last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2026 shall be at least INR 75 Cr.
2.3 Key personnel: Project Manager — PMP certified with minimum 15 years of experience, having led at least one expressway or highway project.
2.4 Certification: Valid ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certificates.
2.5 The bidder shall have been in business for at least 10 years.
2.6 The bidder shall not have been blacklisted by any Central/State agency (declaration).

title: Design-build of 60 MLD Water Treatment Plant with O&M
story: AT_RISK — the two strongest PMs' PMP lapses 16 days after the bid date; the agent names safe alternates. Turnover is AT_RISK too: FY 2026-27 accounts are not on file yet, so the average rests on two of the three years.
text:
Qualifying Requirements
(i) Experience: three similar works (water treatment, water supply or sewerage & drainage) each of value not less than 40% of the estimated cost of INR 60 Cr completed in the last 7 years; or two works of 60%; or one work of 80%.
(ii) Two Project Managers holding a valid PMP certification on the bid due date, with at least 12 years' experience each, having executed water treatment or water supply projects.
(iii) Average annual turnover of the last three financial years not less than INR 150 Cr.
(iv) ISO 14001:2015 environmental management certification.

title: Construction of Major Bridge across River (Large Bridges)
story: FAIL on similar works — the agent shows near misses and who could lead a JV.
text:
Eligibility
1. Similar work experience: completed bridge works (large bridges or bridges & flyovers) in the last 7 years: one work >= 80% of the estimated cost of INR 450 Cr, or two works >= 60%, or three works >= 40%.
2. Average annual turnover over the last 3 financial years of at least INR 200 Cr.
3. A Project Manager with PMP certification and 20 years' experience who has led bridge works.
4. CPWD Class I registration.

title: Institutional Buildings Complex (Phase II)
story: FAIL by INR 1.08 Cr on turnover — in a year whose figure was restated; the conflict trail explains why.
text:
Pre-qualification
A. Annual Turnover >= INR 240 Cr in each of the last 3 financial years (audited).
B. Similar works (buildings or small buildings): one completed work of at least INR 72 Cr, or two of INR 54 Cr, or three of INR 36 Cr, in the last 7 years.
C. Minimum 15 years in business.
D. ISO 9001:2015.

title: Major River Bridge with Approach Flyover (EPC)
story: Either/or clause met on its second alternative (two flyovers of 35 Cr+), which a first-option reading would turn into NO-BID. The AbsenceAuditor hands clause 1 back: the strongest bridge has no client letter, so the EvidenceHunter re-selects a referenced one; for clause 2 the referenced works fall short, so it keeps the original. No relied-on fact has claim history, so the Planner skips the ConflictSentinel.
text:
Eligibility Criteria (technical envelope)
1. Major bridge experience: the bidder shall have completed at least one large bridge work of value not less than INR 70 Cr during the last 7 years. Client reference letters shall be enclosed for the work claimed.
2. Approach flyover experience: either one completed flyover / ROB work of value at least INR 60 Cr, or two completed flyover / ROB works each of value at least INR 35 Cr, in the last 7 years.
3. Valid ISO 9001:2015 quality management certificate.
4. The bidder shall have been in business for at least 10 years.
5. Bid security of INR 1 Cr in the form of a bank guarantee, with a signed integrity pact.
